criteria.reject_or_reduce_if: component equations cannot be obtained from one parent action or GR null nesting fails
mapping assumes the desired observable or silently identifies distinct C lanes
KMS, PSD, entropy, or exchange accounting fails, or trace must feed back as a state
principal system is not strongly hyperbolic, becomes superluminal, or requires clipping
agreement requires in-sample alpha_Phi_K fitting, causal leakage persists, or holdout is consumed for tuning
state/POVM positivity, CPTP, Born normalization, no-signalling, or interpretation invariance fails
GR limit requires deleting equations, curved constraints fail, or observables depend on gauge choice
ghost, anomaly, nonunitarity, nonrenormalizability outside declared EFT, or no falsifiable observable
improvement exists only in calibration data and disappears on uncertainty-aware holdout

rule: a branch failure cannot be hidden by averaging with a passing methodological category
